references.text: Parallel account where the Israelites admit their sin and decide to go up to the Promised Land, even though the Lord had warned them against it.
Describes the consequence of the Israelites' arrogant attempt to go up to the mountain without the Lord's blessing, which resulted in defeat.
Continuation of the account where the Lord warns the people not to go up and fight because He is not with them.
The people promise to do everything the Lord has commanded, similar to the vow the Israelites make here.
Achan's confession 'we have sinned against the Lord' uses the same confessional formula as the Israelites in Deuteronomy 1:41.
The Israelites confess their sin against the Lord with similar wording.
Israel's confession 'we have sinned against the Lord' reflects the words in Deuteronomy 1:41.
